glossary.definition: (1) "Authority having jurisdiction" means an organization, office, agency, or individual responsible for enforcing the requirements under this section.
glossary.source_title: Section 3737.07 - Inspection of protective door assemblies.

glossary.definition: (2) "NFPA 101" means the standards for life safety code published by the national fire protection association, which includes the NFPA 80 standards for fire doors and other opening protectives.
glossary.source_title: Section 3737.07 - Inspection of protective door assemblies.

glossary.definition: (4) "Qualified inspector" means a person, who by possession of a recognized degree, certificate, professional standing, or skill, and who, by knowledge, training, and experience, has demonstrated the ability to deal with the subject matter, the work, or the project.
glossary.source_title: Section 3737.07 - Inspection of protective door assemblies.

glossary.definition: (5) "School building" means a structure used for the instruction of students by a school governing authority.
